knowledgeBase.title: Network / VPN problems
steps: Check that Wi-Fi or the network cable is connected.
Restart your router or toggle Airplane mode on and off.
Disconnect and reconnect to the VPN.
Restart your computer and try again.

knowledgeBase.title: Printer not working
steps: Check power, paper and toner.
Make sure the correct printer is selected.
Clear the print queue and restart the printer.
Reinstall the printer driver if it still fails.

knowledgeBase.title: Password or login issues
steps: Check that Caps Lock is off.
Use the 'Forgot password' link to reset it.
Wait 15 minutes if your account is locked.
Submit a ticket if you still cannot sign in.

knowledgeBase.title: Slow or frozen computer
steps: Save your work and restart the computer.
Close apps you are not using.
Check free disk space and install pending updates.
Report it if the problem keeps coming back.

knowledgeBase.title: Email problems
steps: Check your internet connection.
Sign out and back in to your mail app.
Check your mailbox storage quota.
Try webmail to see if the problem is with the app.

knowledgeBase.title: Software installation / errors
steps: Restart the application and your computer.
Make sure the app is up to date.
Note the exact error message.
Submit a ticket with the error and the software name for installation requests.

knowledgeBase.title: Suspicious email or virus
steps: Do not click links or open attachments.
Disconnect from the network if you think you are infected.
Do not enter passwords on unknown pages.
Submit a High priority Security ticket right away.
